$comment: Hero (picture half of the homepage hero) design directions: four pedestal-free alternatives to the baseline stepped-pedestal trio. Each direction has a 16:9 desktop plate and a 4:5 mobile plate; the three approved flacons are composited onto the plates (never generated). Concept ids equal the card directions in src/config/homepage-assets.ts so one preview bar drives both. Files are registered in public/images/assets-manifest.json as `hero-<concept>`. Checked by `pnpm home:images check`.

baseline.note: The shipped hero: three flacons on stepped honed travertine pedestals (kept as the default until a direction is chosen).

desktop.visibleShare: about 54% of the width at object-position 72% 50% (the picture box is ~square next to the text panel)
desktop.trio: all three flacons inside x 35-91% of the frame

mobile.visibleShare: the central ~62% band vertically (the box is landscape on a phone)
mobile.trio: all three flacons inside the central band, x 12-88%

overlay.ticket: `.rh-ticket` (LAUNCH OFFER card) overlaps the bottom of the picture box by 46 px at every size: 6% of the box height at 1440x900 (box 713x739), 15% at 375 wide (box 376x301)
overlay.rule: keep the bottom quarter of the 16:9 plate and the bottom third of the 4:5 plate calm (plain surface, no props, no highlights); the ticket is an opaque off-white card, no text sits on the picture, so legibility never depends on the picture

flaconSpec.rule: no pedestal, stand, block or stool anywhere; the three bottles stand on the ground at slightly different depths
flaconSpec.approved: 50 ml thick-base flint glass flacon, heavy matte black cap, off-white cotton-paper label THE RARESKIN / name / ESSENTIALS | 50ml, crystal-clear liquid
flaconSpec.briefLabel: EXTRAIT DE PARFUM · 50 ML / 1.7 FL. OZ. and the amber / champagne / cognac liquid colours of the brief are NOT adopted (decision of 2026-11-06: approved mockups). A generator never draws the bottle: the label comes out garbled

composite.desktop: AURÉVAN x 43% / VAYRÉN x 83% / ORVÉLIS x 63% (middle, slightly behind, scale 0.92) of the 16:9 frame, ground y 74% (middle 71%), bottle height about 46% of the frame

tools.kling: kling-image-v3_0_omni text_to_image, aspect 16:9 and 3:4 (cropped to 4:5), about 2 credits per plate (8 plates = 16 credits)
tools.flux: FLUX.1 has no negative field: the plate prompts avoid product words instead

concepts.label: Grounded stone
concepts.direction: The trio stands directly on a honed pale limestone floor in morning light, at three depths, with a bergamot half, jasmine and a cinnamon quill lying between the bottles. No pedestal, no stand.

desktop.prompt: Fine-art product photography background with no product in it, wide landscape 16:9 frame, shot perfectly level and straight-on with the camera at the height of the floor, the line where the wall meets the floor exactly horizontal. A wide pale honed limestone floor that runs edge to edge and to the bottom of the frame, with no borders, no tray and no edges, meets a lime-washed off-white plaster wall a little more than halfway down the frame. Soft early-morning window light at about 5200 K from the upper left, one diagonal sun bar on the wall, long soft shadows to the right. On the floor, in the middle band of the frame and far apart from each other, lie one freshly sliced bergamot half in the left third of the frame, and, in the right third, one cinnamon quill and two white jasmine petals. Across the middle of the floor, between them, there is a wide, calm, empty stretch, level and evenly lit, about three times as wide as it is deep, with nothing on it. The bottom quarter of the frame is calm, plain, evenly toned limestone with no props, no bright highlights and no pattern. No people, no faces, no hands, no text, no logos. 100 mm lens at f/5.6, fine natural film grain. Palette of ivory, pale stone, soft lime green and a little warm brown.

The wide middle of the frame is empty: only calm grains and the plain wall; nothing stands anywhere in the frame. The bottom quarter of the frame is calm, plain, evenly toned grains with no props, no bright highlights and no pattern. No people, no faces, no hands, no text, no logos. 100 mm lens at f/5.6, fine natural film grain. Palette of ivory, amber, umber and black.

brief.concept: Three flacons aligned in a row on a seamless white reflective studio surface. A clean, manicured hand lifts the matte black cap off the centre flacon (VAYRÉN), revealing the black spray nozzle.
brief.lighting: High-key commercial studio lighting, soft specular contact reflections below, zero background clutter.
brief.prompt: Commercial studio product photography for THE RARESKIN. Three 50ml luxury perfume flacons (AURÉVAN, VAYRÉN, ORVÉLIS) standing in a row on a smooth, reflective white studio floor. A manicured hand enters from top right, lifting the matte black cylindrical cap off the center bottle to expose the black spray nozzle. Liquids in pale champagne, deep amber, and cognac. High-key lighting, soft contact reflections, seamless white background, Hasselblad H6D-100c, 85mm, f/8, ultra-clean --ar 16:9 --style raw --v 6.1
brief.promptNote: the brief's own wording, kept verbatim. A generator never draws the bottle (the label comes out garbled), so this prompt is NOT run as it stands: the plate prompt below is.

desktop.prompt: Studio photograph on a seamless pure white background, no floor line, no horizon, no table, no shadow plane. A manicured woman's bare right forearm comes straight down from the top edge of the frame, wrist and forearm clearly visible, no sleeve; the hand, seen from the front and slightly from above, thumb pad in front and index fingertip behind, gently pinches the two sides of a small matte black cylinder only as wide as two fingers side by side and as tall as it is wide, lifted in the middle of the frame; the other fingers relaxed and softly curled; short natural almond nails, natural skin, no jewellery. The small cylinder looks small in the hand. Nothing else is in the frame. Soft diffused light from the left, high-key, 85 mm lens, ultra-clean, fine natural film grain.
desktop.usedAs: roll E of 6 (2026-11-07): only the hand and forearm are used. Lessons: ask for a pure white ground (no floor, no table), the forearm coming from the top edge, and a SMALL cylinder ('two fingers wide, looks small in the hand'): the generator draws the object far too big for the hand otherwise, and scaling the hand to the real cap then makes it child-sized

plate.mobile: not generated: a 4:5 crop (1229x1536) of the desktop plate, composited with its own bottle spacing

production.method: Plate = floor + hand + lifted cap (generated). The three approved flacons are composited under it with place_bottles.py: AURÉVAN and ORVÉLIS capped, the centre flacon UNCAPPED (option nocap=1: the approved art minus its cap, a drawn black atomizer nozzle on the chrome collar).
production.centre: the centre flacon (the brief says VAYRÉN) stands under the lifted cap, its nozzle a few mm below it; the hand's own cap is the generated one (a plain matte black cylinder), sized to the approved cap by choosing the flacon scale from the cap's apparent width
risks: a generated hand can have wrong fingers: roll until the pinch is clean
the generated cap has no grain: acceptable at ~70 px in the hero box, but flag it
hand and cap must sit in frame x 40-85% (the hero box shows ~54% of the frame)

production.centre: the fingertip decides the right flacon's position and scale (nozzle top = fingertip); the other two follow at the same scale and ground line
risks: the fingertip has to land on the nozzle: the bottle is composited OVER the plate, so the nozzle top is placed at the fingertip's lower edge (touching), not under the finger pad
trio + cap need ~48% of the frame width: the hero box shows ~54%, so the bottle scale is 0.46 and the mobile crop uses 0.40
a generated hand can have wrong fingers: roll until the pose is clean

brief.concept: Three smooth, seamless matte-white architectural cylindrical columns at subtle staggered heights against an ethereal off-white studio backdrop. Each column holds one flacon.
brief.lighting: Soft directional studio key light creating smooth, delicate vertical gradients around the curved plinths.
brief.prompt: Minimalist high-fashion studio photography of THE RARESKIN collection. Three 50ml perfume flacons displayed on three matte white cylindrical plinths of varying heights. Clear heavy glass, weighted black magnetic caps, centered labels. Diffused studio strobe lighting with soft curved shadows on the white columns. Ethereal light-grey to pure-white gradient background. Clean, sculptural, editorial luxury, 50mm, f/8 --ar 16:9 --style raw --v 6.1
brief.promptNote: the brief's own wording, kept verbatim. A generator never draws the bottle (the label comes out garbled), so this prompt is NOT run as it stands: the plate prompt below is.

desktop.prompt: Minimalist high-fashion studio photography background, wide landscape 16:9 frame, shot straight-on slightly above the lowest column top. Three smooth seamless matte white cylindrical columns of clearly different heights (the left one medium, the middle one the lowest, the right one the tallest) stand close together in a row in the middle and right of the frame on a seamless white studio floor, in front of a seamless ethereal light-grey to white gradient wall. Each column has a wide, perfectly flat, empty top, its diameter about half its own height, with nothing on it. Diffused studio strobe light from the upper left with soft curved shadows and delicate vertical gradients on the columns. The left third of the frame is quiet and empty. The bottom quarter of the frame is calm, plain, evenly toned white floor. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark. 50 mm lens at f/8, ultra-clean, fine natural film grain.

production.method: Plate = three generated cylinders. Each flacon stands on a cylinder top: the top's ellipse (centre x, near-edge y, width) is MEASURED on the plate and the flacon is placed at the centre line of the top, base 60% toward the front edge, scale = 0.8 x top width / 651.
production.centre: staggered heights come from the plate; if the generator makes them equal, re-roll
risks: the generator may draw a shelf, a fourth column, a tray or a visible floor edge: re-roll
the hero box shows ~54% of the frame: the three columns must sit within frame x 36-86%
the brief's own wording is kept in brief.prompt; plinths are the point of this variant (the earlier hero brief asked for none)

A low, wide, clean geometric arrangement of three matte off-white rectangular blocks of gently increasing height, like three shallow stairs rising from left to right, the whole group no taller than a third of the frame, standing in the middle and right of the frame on a seamless white floor, each block with a wide, perfectly flat, empty top, in front of a seamless plain pale wall with no mouldings, no skirting board, no columns and no ornament. desktop.usedAs: roll B of 2 (2026-11-07). Roll A (shallow slabs cut by the right frame edge) was not used. Lesson: ask for a compact group no taller than a third of the frame and a plain wall

production.method: Plate = three generated stepped blocks + a bergamot wheel and a vanilla pod. Each flacon stands on a step top: the top's front edge and width are MEASURED on the plate; flacon base 60% toward the front edge; scale from the narrowest top. The props stay on the floor at the foot of the lowest step.
production.centre: the lowest step is on the left (nearest the text panel): the props sit left of the trio, inside the box on desktop
risks: the generator may round the blocks, draw a staircase with risers it cannot fit a bottle on, or put the fruit on a plate: re-roll
the bottle is bigger than a step top on a thin plate: scale it down
the props must stay inside frame x 36-86% to show in the hero box

referenceVariantsNote.decided: 2026-11-07 brief ('Engineering 4 Hero Image Systems from Absolute Visual References'). Preview with ?hero=1..4 or the HERO bar; src/config/hero.config.ts: activeHeroVariant.
referenceVariantsNote.specKept: bottle = the approved pixels (label ESSENTIALS | 50ml, crystal-clear liquid). The brief's EXTRAIT DE PARFUM · 50 ML / 1.7 FL. OZ. label and champagne / amber / cognac liquids are not adopted: same decision as 2026-11-06 (approved mockups).
referenceVariantsNote.newPixels: the uncapped flacon (nozzle drawn on the approved collar), the hand and, in variant 1, the cap it holds, are the only non-approved pixels.
referenceVariantsNote.background: the page is --paper #fafaf7 and the hero text panel is warm stone, not pure white: the plates are high-key neutrals and the picture box is flush with the panel, so there is no white-on-white seam to match.
